d:
Once a year on Christmas Eve the world tunes in to the live broadcast of A Festival of Nine Lessons and Carols from King's College Chapel. This magical service has taken place here since 1918, and 100 years later we celebrated the Centenary of this Christmas institution.
Recorded in high resolution surround-sound, the service is now available to keep in its entirety, captured in a sound quality better than ever before: A Festival of Nine Lessons & Carols: The Centenary Service.
In dulci jubilo (German traditional, arr. Robert Lucas de Pearsall), sung by the Choir of King's College, Cambridge.
